scope: C-010 optional task command contract, owner/session/date guards, PostgreSQL CAS and idempotency, continuation window, Mini Program unknown-outcome recovery and pressure-free interaction

assertions: the strict task command binds command, original product date, published task ID, expected revision and closed status enum
owner, session, continuation grant and guard epochs remain server-only
interaction responses are the existing client-safe DailyInteractionState projection
same command and payload replay one result while changed payload or mismatched idempotency header conflicts
stale expected revision returns the latest strict interaction without owner/session/guard leakage
Safety, closed and expired continuation responses never produce optimistic task success
read and update routes emit stable low-cardinality operation codes

T-C010-DB-001.selector: C-008 real PostgreSQL idempotent generation, publication and guard fences
assertions: real PostgreSQL 18 lets only one of two task CAS writers win and returns the latest revision to the loser
same command replay and semantic no-op do not increment task revision
a session-bound DLY-003 grant permits the original day at 04:05 and expires at the 04:30 boundary
a live DAY deletion guard blocks the task write and the task never changes the independent light fact
historical interaction reads the frozen task state without regenerating content

T-C010-MINIAPP-001.selector: C-009 daily coordinator / C-010 optional task
assertions: the client persists one attempted command only after an unknown network outcome and retries that same identity
CAS conflict replaces the cached interaction with the latest strict server view
expired continuation becomes read-only and offline never creates a queued write
INTERESTED, COMPLETED, SKIPPED and UNMARKED remain independent of is_lit
